Strength: Long standby endurance (48hr) suits extended overwatch positions; dual electric/diesel-generator power
Limitation: Lighter armament than larger combat UGVs like Ironclad; smaller traction/load capacity
Estimated quantity available: Fielded numbers not publicly disclosed
employment_notes: Multifunctional design combining fire support and trailer-based transport in one small, cheap platform - illustrating the trend toward small, disposable, purpose-built ground robots rather than large multi-role ones
contrast_vs_traditional: Moroz splits its role between fire support and logistics — itself a sign that traditional doctrine's separate categories for combat and resupply vehicles are blurring at the small-UGV scale, where a single remotely operated platform is cheap enough to be worth building for more than one mission rather than specializing the way a manned vehicle would.
